We are looking for a proactive, result-oriented, and motivated Business Development Associate to support our business growth initiatives. The candidate should possess excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, along with a strong interest in sales, marketing, and business development.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.

* Follow up with leads and prospects to move them through the sales pipeline.

* Participate in sales meetings, training sessions, client meetings, and business development initiatives.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to identify customer needs and communicate value propositions effectively.
* Good research, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Familiarity with MS Office or Google Workspace.
* Basic knowledge of CRM tools and sales processes is an advantage.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
* Willingness to learn, adapt, and work towards measurable business targets.

* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of client calls, meetings, and follow-ups completed.
* Lead-to-customer conversion rate.
* Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets.
* Number of new clients acquired.
* Quality of customer relationships and follow-up.
* Accuracy and timely updating of CRM records.
* Contribution to overall business growth.

The ideal candidate should be self-motivated, confident, customer-focused, and comfortable interacting with prospective clients. They should demonstrate a positive attitude, a willingness to learn, and the ability to work in a target-driven environment.

Candidates with experience in lead generation, telesales, field sales, digital sales, or client acquisition will have an added advantage.
